COLDWAR_COL_measures_initialize = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = COLDWAR_COL_tension }
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_tension = 55 }
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_measure_casework = {
	COLDWAR_COL_prepare_measures = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_COL_measure_casework_available = yes
		}
		add_political_power = -20
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.025 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		17 = {
			set_state_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_COL_measure_casework_cooldown days = 180 }
			set_state_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_COL_measure_casework_live days = 180 }
		}
		17 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_cells = -2 } }
		17 = { clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_COL_cells min = 25 max = 90 } clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_COL_tension min = 20 max = 95 } COLDWAR_COL_measure_state_budget = yes COLDWAR_COL_apply_domestic = yes }
		COLDWAR_COL_refresh_case = yes
	}
}

		}
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_measure_cost = 0.003 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_measure_reform_live
		}
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_measure_cost = 0.004 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_measure_internment_live
		}
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_measure_cost = 0.006 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_measure_roundtable_live
		}
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_measure_cost = 0.006 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_measure_ceasefire_live
		}

}

			tag = GER

		COLDWAR_GER_1970_security_weekly_budget = yes

	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_refresh_measures_view = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_COL_measure_ira_available = yes
			COLDWAR_COL_case_target_available = yes
		}
		var:COLDWAR_COL_case_target = { COLDWAR_COL_measures_initialize = yes COLDWAR_COL_measure_state_budget = yes set_variable = { PREV.COLDWAR_COL_case_tension = COLDWAR_COL_tension } set_variable = { PREV.COLDWAR_COL_case_measure_cost = COLDWAR_COL_measure_cost } }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_case_cost = COLDWAR_COL_case_measure_cost }
	}
}

	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_tension > 69 }
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_case_drift = 0.5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_tension < 36 }
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_case_drift = -0.5 }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_COL_tension min = 20 max = 95 }
}

	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_cells > 44 }
			controller = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_incident_recent } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_measure_ceasefire_live
			}
			random_list = {
				98 = {

				}
				2 = {
					controller = { set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_COL_incident_recent days = 90 } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_colonial_contacts.3 } }
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_tension > 69 }
				}
				random_list = {
					75 = {

					}

						controller = { set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_COL_incident_recent days = 90 } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_colonial_contacts.3 } }
					}
				}
			}

				random_list = {
					85 = {

					}
					15 = {
						controller = { set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_COL_incident_recent days = 90 } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_colonial_contacts.3 } }

		}
	}
